The discussion covered minor data fixes related to demographics. One participant confirmed fixing the alert system, specifically ensuring 'stage' was correctly reported.

A separate idea for improvement was discussed: implementing a rigorous monitoring and testing process similar to how certain external platforms (like Yandex) conduct scheduled checks (e.g., every Wednesday). This would involve simulating various failure scenarios, such as backend failures or departmental reactions, to ensure system resilience.
